to load a skill's SKILL.md in full when the task matches its description.
Resolve relative paths in a skill against its directory.

  <skill>
    <name>release</name>
    <description>Cut a release of xyz...</description>
    <location>/home/runner/work/xyz/xyz/.pi/skills/release/SKILL.md</location>
  </skill>
</available_skills>
```

- Locations are absolute. Package skills live in `$RUNNER_TEMP/pi-action-extensions-*`, which the coding tools can read.
